register_gap: Onboarding runs one ~52pt serif act per screen, exactly one 13pt tracked-caps eyebrow, zero filled containers, and 40-60% untouched cream held as a single composed band; the app stacks 2-3 caps registers before its display line even starts (home: date caps + 'DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20' caps + 'FROM JENI' teaser) and runs 4-6 competing grammars per scroll (display, ledger, chips, radio checklist, dismissible banner, chevron list-rows). Chrome the onboarding never shows returns everywhere: seven chevrons on one becoming screen, a connect/× banner on home, white shadowed bubbles with tails in chat, an outlined widget card, a truncated headline with an ellipsis. Numbers the onboarding sets as 72pt serif heroes ('500 calories') fall to 22pt centered dashboard columns (STARTED/NOW/GOAL on the weight page). Same three faces, but the app reads as a well-made productivity tool at roughly twice the ink and half the scale of the founder's signed standard.
onboarding_dna: One serif act per screen: a single ~52pt JeniHeroSerif statement, two lines max, exactly one italic word ('what are you here for, mostly?'); app display lines run 38-44pt and share the screen with 3+ other grammars.
Exactly one tracked-caps eyebrow per screen (13pt, ~+3pt tracking, centered: HER ARRIVAL / HER FOOD STORY); the becoming landing carries 12 tracked-caps items at once.
40-60% of the canvas is untouched cream composed as one band: beat 10 ends its content at ~27% of screen height and rests; beat 19 floats its act at the optical third with a ghost hint at the foot.
Zero filled containers anywhere: choices are naked 22-26pt text over 0.5pt hairlines with 1.5pt-stroke outline circles; no cards, no fills, no shadows in 22 beats.
Numbers are serif display heroes: '500' at ~72pt with a 28pt italic unit beside it and rose sub-accents; receipt values right-aligned ~24pt with the one charged word in italic serif ('food is fuel').
One affordance per screen: a single ~60pt cocoa pill ('show me') or a ghost 'tap to continue' — never two competing calls, never a chevron, never a dismiss control.
Photography is full-bleed and chrome-free, owning the top ~50% of the canvas with the cream panel simply rising over it (poke-bowl beat); nothing is framed in a card.
Total header chrome under ~30pt of ink: five 1pt progress dashes plus a naked back chevron.

screen_directions.direction: Collapse three stacked metadata registers into one: 'MONDAY, JULY 27' (15pt tracked caps) stays as the sole eyebrow, camera disc as the single utility. The 'DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20' caps line dies; the truncated FROM JENI teaser dies — jeni's opening line BECOMES the display act, full two lines at 40-44pt serif, never elided, ↗ into the letter (p4's top already proves this composition). Below: one serif number band (860 at ~44pt + italic 'room for ~600'), then the day's 2-3 plan lines as seal lines — naked 24pt serif on 0.5pt hairlines ending in a hollow ✦. Steps folds to one quiet ledger line (no chevron, no 'counted for you'); the connect banner dies. The screen becomes a daily broadsheet: eyebrow, headline, one stat, three lines to keep, ~40% cream at rest.

The landing stops being a settings index and becomes this week's issue: wordmark + week eyebrow stay, jeni's read stays as the 40pt cover line. The lead signal earns a full-width pull — its chart drawn naked on cream at ~130pt tall, no card, no border — over a 28pt serif caption. Remaining signals set as contents lines at varied pitch: 11pt Fraunces eyebrow + 24pt serif statement, all seven chevrons deleted, hairlines only between groups; 'tap to open' deleted — the lines are the doors. Inside the story pages, the poster top half stays; the bottom drops its dashboard: STARTED/NOW/GOAL columns reset as one right-aligned serif ledger, the duplicated caps bar-labels merge to one row, the second same-message paragraph dies, and the roman folio yields to the fore-edge.

The truest room in the app — protect it and finish it. Drop the letter block ~80pt toward the optical center so the emptiness reads composed, not leftover; keep JENI + hairline + italic 'monday' and the right-aligned 'jeni ♥' sign-off exactly as they are. Replace the doubled call ('reply' pill + 'keep it ♥' ghost) with one: 'reply' stays the single dark pill, and keeping becomes the seal — a hollow ✦ at the sign-off that fills with the bloom and soft haptic, filing the letter. One act, one seal, a signed page.

Kill the bubble grammar: no white fills, no tails, no drop shadows — they introduce a fourth surface color the register doesn't own. Jeni's turns become typeset paragraphs flush left, 19pt DMSans cocoa on bare cream with a hairline lead-in (the letter's own grammar); her turns sit right-aligned in italic ~19pt with at most an 8% rose wash and no outline. Keep the italic 'today' rule — already perfect. The trend widget loses its outlined card: a naked ~60pt sparkline with a caps link. The input pill remains the only chrome. The thread becomes a printed interview — correspondence continued, not Messages reskinned.

checklist_signature.at_rest: A plan item is a line, not a row: 24pt JeniHeroSerif lowercase sitting on a 0.5pt hairline that runs to the right margin, terminated by a hollow ✦ at 16pt in cocoa at ~30% opacity. No leading circle, no card, no fill — the radio grammar dies entirely. Open items rest at full-ink cocoa; the hairline and the hollow mark are the only signs the line still waits.
checklist_signature.completion: Press-and-hold ~400ms — a signature, not a tap. The hairline redraws itself in rose from the text outward over ~320ms; the ✦ fills and blooms 1.0 → 1.25 → 1.0 with one soft haptic landing exactly at the bloom's apex; a 15pt italic 'kept' settles beneath the mark; the line's ink eases from 100% to ~55% cocoa. The item is never struck through or checked — it is countersigned by jeni's own mark.
checklist_signature.day_complete: When the last line seals, the day earns its seal: the filled ✦ marks lift off their lines with a 60ms stagger, drift up, and merge into a single 20pt filled ✦ beside 'MONDAY, JULY 27'; one silk shimmer crosses the date line; one warm haptic swell, nothing louder. The plan lines rest at 55% like closed ledger entries, and the sealed date is what her history shows tomorrow.
checklist_signature.why_inevitable: The ✦ already IS the product's mark — it names 'today' in the tab bar and sparks jeni's accents — and onboarding already taught her that acts end in a signing ceremony (the her-file signature beat). Sealing each kept line with the coach's own glyph turns the checklist from task-completion into countersigned correspondence: the one interaction only JeniFit could own, built from a glyph, a hairline, rose, and one haptic.

becoming_pagination.description: Replace 'i · of xii' with the edge of a held magazine: a centered rail of twelve 1pt hairline ticks (~14pt wide, 6pt gaps) above the tab bar — leaves in the hand, not numerals. Read leaves sit at cocoa 40%, unread at 15%; the current leaf is rose, 3pt tall and slightly longer, sliding with a ~200ms ease as she flips. Beneath it, 11pt tracked ghost caps at ~25% whisper the next leaf — 'NEXT · SUGAR INTAKE' — so position is felt as thumb-depth into the issue plus the scent of the next page, never counted in romans.

deletions: p5_functional_home: the 'DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 · FINDING STEADY >' second caps line — week identity lives in becoming; home keeps exactly one eyebrow.

p5_functional_home: the truncated 'FROM JENI back after 10 days. this is day 12, n… ↗' teaser row — an editorial product never elides its own headline; the letter opening becomes the display act instead.
p5_functional_home: the 'hungrier weeks have a rhythm… connect / ×' dismissible banner — outline-pill-plus-close is productivity chrome; the cycle line belongs in jeni's own voice.
p5_functional_home: the steps row's chevron and 'counted for you' subline — the number remains as one quiet ledger line.
p2_becoming: all seven right-rail chevrons and the 'tap to open' hint — the serif lines are the doors.
folio_scrollpager: the 'i · of xii' roman folio and the centered STARTED / NOW / GOAL three-column stat table — fore-edge instead; stats reset as one right-aligned serif ledger.
folio_v6: the duplicated MORNING / AFTERNOON / EVENING caps row (printed under the bars and again above the percents) and the second same-message insight paragraph — each thing said once.
chat_final: white bubble fills, tails, and drop shadows, plus the outlined border on the trend widget — typeset turns and a naked chart on cream.
one_transformative_move: Adopt the onboarding constitution on every app screen — one eyebrow, one serif act, one affordance — and make the ✦ seal the product's only state-mark: every chevron, radio circle, banner, and bubble is replaced by typeset lines that end, when kept, in jeni's countersign. That single move turns Home into a broadsheet, becoming into a cover, chat into an interview — the app stops organizing her day and starts publishing it.
